theme: stagehands re-setting a theater between scenes in the dark
title: Wings as Registers: Blackout Scene-Swap Choreography
strategies: clear-and-rebuild baseline: every blackout, evacuate the whole stage to the wings, then refill from scratch, parking leftovers and pushing them back (checker's own internal baseline)
per-window greedy: evacuate only cells that actually change, cell-index push order, wing chosen purely by free capacity (no precedence awareness, no lookahead)

prop-lifetime lookahead: push evacuees in descending order of when they are next needed on stage across the WHOLE remaining scene sequence (soonest-needed prop ends up on top), and choose wings to keep each push precedence-clean
invalid: claims to push a nonexistent prop id -- must score 0 under strict feasibility checking
